actual: The last step cannot be opened at all: the rail's 'Curriculum' and 'Prerequisites and waivers' are not links (they read 'Finish Sessions first'), and navigating directly to /programs/templates/115/setup/prerequisites-waivers redirects back to /programs/templates/115/setup/sessions (seen twice, in PRG-035 and PRG-036). There is therefore no held Create button reading 'Finish Sessions to create the program.' to read or press. The expected held-Create state does not exist in this build; the app gates the last step by redirect instead. PRG-036 step 2 also fails on the same behaviour: the prerequisites address lands on /setup/sessions, not /setup/curriculum as expected. (PRG-036 steps 1, 3, 4 pass: reload keeps Sessions; the old /setup/waivers address lands on the furthest step; /programs/new/anything goes to /programs/new/basics.) Draft template 115 'PRG-035 Test Program' remains at Sessions, '2 of 5 steps done', 40%.
expected: Create reads 'Finish {steps} to create the program.' naming Sessions, the rail marks it, and pressing it does not create the program. The prerequisites address sends you to /setup/curriculum.
steps: Start a new program, walk to Sessions and leave the class size empty.
Open the last step directly from the rail or by address.
Read the Create button and press it.
title: PRG-035/036: no held Create button — the wizard redirects away from the last step instead of showing 'Finish Sessions to create the program.'
trail: Batch 3a, 2026-11-17, Cricmax Test_AP, draft template 115 (PRG-035 Test Program).
